_ayuda: Cada viaje agrupa varios 'lugares' (los de fotos.json). 'subtitulo' sale bajo el nombre en el anillo; 'texto' aparece a la izquierda al pasar el ratón por ese grupo. Cambia los textos a tu gusto; el orden de esta lista es el orden alrededor del círculo.
intro: Every trip leaves behind a different way of seeing. Here they are grouped by destination — hover over each group to read its story.

viajes.texto: Home. From the high plains to the Cantabrian Sea: the familiar, seen as if for the first time.
Sunsets over the water and villages clinging to the mountainside.
City escapes: canals, domes and façades mirrored in the water.
Skyscrapers, bridges and lights that never go out.

viajes.subtitulo: San Francisco · Sausalito · Yosemite · San Diego
viajes.texto: From the fog of the Bay to the beaches of the south, by way of Yosemite’s granite.
Red rock, light that cuts like a blade, and a scale no photograph can hold.
Waterfalls in the jungle, fire in the Pacific night and palm trees leaning over the Caribbean.
Loose photographs still waiting for a trip.
